drivers.description: Lord of the Rings, The (10.02 Limited Edition)
drivers.variant_notes: Stern game ROM revision 10.02, the firmware of the 2009 Limited Edition. PinMAME declares it a clone of lotr sharing init_lotr, which is shared emulator routing, not shared hardware. Against the 2003 machine's root driver it differs only in the CPU game ROM (lotrcpua.a02 against lotrcpua.a00); the display ROM lotrdspa.a00 and the LOTR_SND sound set are the same. Its own flash-lamp test pulses solenoid 28, which the 2003 firmware never drives. It is this edition's production firmware, so it is identical to the machine it describes.
